entries.title: Proverbs 20:1
segments: Wine is a mocker, strong drink a brawler; And whosoever erreth thereby is not wise.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:2
segments: The terror of a king is as the roaring of a lion: He that provoketh him to anger sinneth [against] his own life.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:3
segments: It is an honor for a man to keep aloof from strife; But every fool will be quarrelling.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:4
segments: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the winter; Therefore he shall beg in harvest, and have nothing.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:5
segments: Counsel in the heart of man is [like] deep water; But a man of understanding will draw it out.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:6
segments: Most men will proclaim every one his own kindness; But a faithful man who can find?

entries.title: Proverbs 20:7
segments: A righteous man that walketh in his integrity, Blessed are his children after him.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:8
segments: A king that sitteth on the throne of judgment Scattereth away all evil with his eyes.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:9
segments: Who can say, I have made my heart clean, I am pure from my sin?

entries.title: Proverbs 20:10
segments: Diverse weights, and diverse measures, Both of them alike are an abomination to Jehovah.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:11
segments: Even a child maketh himself known by his doings, Whether his work be pure, and whether it be right.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:12
segments: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, Jehovah hath made even both of them.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:13
segments: Love not sleep, let thou come to poverty; Open thine eyes, [and] thou shalt be satisfied with bread.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:14
segments: It is bad, it is bad, saith the buyer; But when he is gone his way, then he boasteth.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:15
segments: There is gold, and abundance of rubies; But the lips of knowledge are a precious jewel.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:16
segments: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger; And hold him in pledge [that is surety] for foreigners.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:17
segments: Bread of falsehood is sweet to a man; But afterwards his mouth shall be filled with gravel.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:18
segments: Every purpose is established by counsel; And by wise guidance make thou war.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:19
segments: He that goeth about as a tale-bearer revealeth secrets; Therefore company not with him that openeth wide his lips.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:20
segments: Whoso curseth his father or his mother, His lamp shall be put out in blackness of darkness.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:21
segments: An inheritance [may be] gotten hastily at the beginning; But the end thereof shall not be blessed.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:22
segments: Say not thou, I will recompense evil: Wait for Jehovah, and he will save thee.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:23
segments: Diverse weights are an abomination to Jehovah; And a false balance is not good.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:24
segments: A man's goings are of Jehovah; How then can man understand his way?

entries.title: Proverbs 20:25
segments: It is a snare to a man rashly to say, [It is] holy, And after vows to make inquiry.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:26
segments: A wise king winnoweth the wicked, And bringeth the [threshing] -wheel over them.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:27
segments: The spirit of man is the lamp of Jehovah, Searching all his innermost parts.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:28
segments: Kindness and truth preserve the king; And his throne is upholden by kindness.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:29
segments: The glory of young men is their strength; And the beauty of old men is the hoary head.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:30
segments: Stripes that wound cleanse away evil; And strokes [reach] the innermost parts.
